title: Can a trading agent who fears death make better decisions?
author: TredOps
selftext:
We want to share with the community the benchmarks we are running on our trading system. We can observe how the agents make decisions under specific conditions and prompt temperature settings, etc.

The flow is as follows:

1 - We create optimized bots that recalibrate every 10 days.

2 - Using the tradeDate, we can simulate exactly which calibration each bot should use, and then we run a signal simulation.

3 - These signals reach a Signal Pool.

4 - Agents review these signals, perform price analysis, and decide whether to buy or not.

Each bar represents a Managed Agent with a virtual capital of approximately 10k

The ones you're referring to as "Sovereigns" are agents who have clear rules: increase their portfolio or they'll be disconnected. The "Professionals" are agents with clear instructions on how to operate.

We have the Benchmark with all the details and conclusions on our website.
